subject.title: fix(browser): add bounded prompt commit diagnostics

question: Should Oracle support `ORACLE_PROMPT_COMMIT_DIAGNOSTICS=1` and its structured event names as a maintained browser-debug interface?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow, but choosing a durable operator configuration and log schema is a product and supportability decision rather than a mechanical correctness fix.

options.title: Adopt the bounded diagnostic contract
options.body: Keep the opt-in variable and stable redacted event schema after real-browser proof confirms it does not perturb prompt submission.

options.title: Keep diagnostics internal
options.body: Request a narrower implementation that reuses existing debug facilities without adding a new supported environment-variable interface.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bounded diagnostic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the opt-in variable and stable redacted event schema after real-browser proof confirms it does not perturb prompt submission.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the browser diagnostic surface make this the best available routing candidate.
